name: Media: Tyler Technologies Data & Insights
description: Provides a custom media type for embedding Tyler Technologies Data & Insights visualizations.

suggests.drupal/csp: Adds the configured allowed hosts to the frame-src Content-Security-Policy directive.

project_description:
This module allows the creation of Media assets from Tyler Technologies Data & Insights . This allows you to manage data and create visualizations within Tyler Technologies Data & Insights and then embed them within Drupal anywhere Media allows, including fields and WYSIWYG.

 Features 
 
 Allows to use Tyler Technologies Data & Insights embeds as media 
 Allows to restrict the hosts from where we can embed 
 If the CSP module is installed, automatically adds those hosts to the frame-src policy. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Works with Drupal 10.3+ and 11 
 
 Installation 
 
 Media: Tyler Technologies Data & Insights can be installed via the standard Drupal installation process. 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Create a new Media Type and select "Tyler Data & Insights". 
 Add the "Administer Media: Tyler Data & Insights allowed hosts" permission to any privileged user that can add hosts. 
 Add the permissions for which roles can create media with this new media type. 
 Go to Configuration > Media > Tyler Technologies Data & Insights settings and add the hosts that you want to embed from.
